description.value:
Boil-sacs, bile lances, blood grenades — the graft leaves your hand and does its work on someone else's body instead.

WET WORK — your thrown Grafts deal bonus damage and splash to adjacent creatures on a hit.

cinderfall.incomplete: This is one of the three Stock-parent cards (chosen via fleshmancer.stock.json's real ChoiceSet+GrantItem), and its own headline mechanic states no number -- there is nothing concrete to build here, and every child card that names this Stock as a prerequisite inherits nothing real to extend either.
